title: Roveia pinned client roll
description: A window-high dark inset card with 40px corners, pinned for four windows: a list of big light (64px) brand names slides up through the middle, the centred one bright and the rest fading with distance, while a panel on the right (wordmark, tags, description) and a full-bleed photo under a veil crossfade to the active brand. Phones get a centred title over a two-column wordmark grid.
notes: desktop: 500svh tall (pinned for 4 windows); phones: content height
one photo slot per brand; empty slots are dark surfaces with a soft glow
CSS scroll-driven only; without support or with reduced motion it is a still card on the first brand
